summary: SportConnect MVP tested end-to-end. 35/35 backend pytest tests passed (public search, auth cookie, enroll mock payment, club dashboard mgmt, claim + admin approve, admin stats/claims, RBAC 401/403). Frontend Playwright flows all passed: Home search bar → Results (158 clubs), club detail, enroll dialog with confirmation, club login → 30 owned clubs + tabs work, admin login → stats, unauth /admin redirects to /login.

issues: '2729 clubs referencies' counts sport occurrences (clubs with multiple sports counted multiple times); DB has 1949 unique clubs. Cosmetic — the label 'clubs' is misleading.
Console a11y warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` on {DialogContent} — add a DialogDescription to remove the Radix warning.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~530 lines) is fine for now but growing — consider splitting routers (auth, clubs, admin) when adding features.
MongoDB _id is correctly excluded via club_public() and projection {_id:0}. Good.
Auth cookies: httpOnly, secure, samesite=none, 7d expiry — matches spec. bcrypt hashing correct ($2b$ format).
seed_admin correctly updates password if it changed. Idempotent.
CORS restricted to FRONTEND_URL with allow_credentials — good.
No brute-force lockout on /auth/login — acceptable for MVP but worth mentioning.
get_current_user swallows generic Exception on ObjectId parse via bare except; consider explicit InvalidId handling for clarity.
